title: restart discipline enforced at lint: unless-stopped or on-failure only
asA: shelf consumer applying the platform-docker-compose-host v1.0.0 blueprint
iWant: the compose-config-lint to enforce a restart policy on every service and refuse on any value outside the two allowed policies (unless-stopped for long-running, on-failure for jobs)
soThat: the operator sees a wrong or missing restart policy at gate time rather than as a stuck container

acceptanceCriteria.description: The compose-config-lint probe asserts every service in the compose.yaml declares a restart policy AND every declared value is one of unless-stopped or on-failure. SIMULATE_UNCLASSIFIED_RESTART=true sets restart: always on the web service and the probe FAILS naming the service and the disallowed value.

F-7 long-running policy: a service classified kind: long-running (a labels: com.stravica.service-kind: long-running convention on the fixture) must declare restart: unless-stopped. SIMULATE_JOB_POLICY_ON_LONG_RUNNING=true sets restart: on-failure on a long-running service and the compose-config-lint FAILS naming the service and the disallowed pairing.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture with a long-running service labelled com.stravica.service-kind: long-running
acceptanceCriteria.then: the lint FAILS naming the service and the pairing "long-running + on-failure"

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-7 job policy: a service classified kind: job must declare restart: on-failure. SIMULATE_LONG_RUNNING_POLICY_ON_JOB=true sets restart: unless-stopped on a job and the lint FAILS naming the service and the disallowed pairing.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture with a job labelled com.stravica.service-kind: job
acceptanceCriteria.then: the lint FAILS naming the service and the pairing "job + unless-stopped"

acceptanceCriteria.description: Missing restart field: SIMULATE_MISSING_RESTART=true removes the restart field from a service. The compose-config-lint FAILS naming the service; every service must declare a restart policy per REQ-004.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the lint FAILS naming the service with no restart policy
